decisions.reason: The source changes only the Title font size; Heading 3 remains a separate style with its existing size and bold weight.
The title-size change does not alter the requirement to implement the specified style catalog across the template set.
Changing the Title font size does not change the NXQ prefix, its application, its condition, or the language of style names.
The source refers specifically to the Title and does not change bullet size, balance, alignment, or scaling behavior.
Title font size is independent of Tab-driven list hierarchy, indentation, and nested-level alignment.
The source does not modify legacy-content paste behavior, stability constraints, or legacy test files.
The Title font-size decision does not affect pasted-table containment or right-hand column positioning.
The source does not change the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after legacy-content pasting.
Setting the Title to 40pt does not change the supported Word environment or general reliability expectations.
The Title font-size decision does not resolve or modify the separate conflict over the templates' default language.
The source changes only Title typography and does not affect numbered-list alignment at multi-digit values.
